title: E-mail notices
description: Choose what Vera sends to your e-mail. The choice is yours alone.

goal_behind.title: Goal behind
goal_behind.description: An e-mail when a goal falls behind its pace.

recurring_week.title: Debits of the week
recurring_week.description: On Monday, what will be charged in the next 7 days, with the name and the amount.

recurring_due.title: Day before a debit
recurring_due.description: An e-mail the day before each charge of the series where you turned the notice on.

portfolio_ex_date_tomorrow.title: Ex-date tomorrow
portfolio_ex_date_tomorrow.description: An e-mail the day before the ex-date of a payout from the assets you hold.

portfolio_payment_today.title: Payout paid today
portfolio_payment_today.description: An e-mail on the day a payout from your assets is paid.

portfolio_assembly_soon.title: Assembly coming up
portfolio_assembly_soon.description: An e-mail before an assembly of the assets you hold.

fixed_income_maturity_soon.title: Fixed income maturity
fixed_income_maturity_soon.description: An e-mail before a fixed income security or Tesouro Direto position matures.

portfolio_weekly_changes.title: Weekly digest: what changed
portfolio_weekly_changes.description: On Monday, an email with the most relevant official documents about your assets. It only arrives when something relevant came out. Premium.

portfolio_monthly_review.title: Month X-ray
portfolio_monthly_review.description: At the start of each month, an email with the main numbers of your portfolio X-ray and the paragraph that explains them. Premium.

toast.off: You will no longer get this notice.

unsubscribe.title: Stop getting this notice?
unsubscribe.body: You stop getting this notice by e-mail. You can turn it back on in Settings, Preferences.
unsubscribe.doneBody: You no longer get the "{{notice}}" notice by e-mail.

errors.invalidToken: This link is no longer valid. Change the notice in Settings, Preferences.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries right now. Try again in a moment.
